title: Slaughter of innocents
html_source:
Reference to the New Testament (Matthew 2). Herod the Great ordered the execution of all male children aged two years or younger in Bethlehem because he was afraid to lose his throne to the newborn King of the Jews, Jesus.

See: https://www.biblegateway.com/passage/?search=Matthew%202&version=NIV
